title: Anne Arrives in Avonlea
teaser: A surprise at Bright River Station changes the Cuthberts’ plans.
questions: Why do Matthew and Marilla want a boy?
They want a boy to help Matthew on the farm.
Where does Matthew go to meet the child?
He goes to Bright River Station.
Who is waiting for Matthew at the station?
Anne Shirley is waiting for him.
Why did Matthew take Anne to Green Gables?
He did not want to leave her alone at the station.
What name does Anne ask Marilla to call her?
She asks Marilla to call her Cordelia.

title: A Sad Story
teaser: On the road to White Sands, Anne tells Marilla about her past.
questions: What did Anne’s parents do for work?
They were teachers.
How did Anne help Mrs. Thomas?
She helped look after Mrs. Thomas’s four children.
How long did Anne live at the orphanage?
She lived there for four months.
Why does Mrs. Blewett want a girl to live with her?
She wants help with her new baby.
What does Marilla decide when she talks to Matthew at home?
She decides that Anne can stay at Green Gables.

title: Red Hair
teaser: A visitor’s comments put Anne’s temper to the test.
questions: Why is Anne crying after Marilla tells her she can stay?
She is crying because she is very happy.
What does Mrs. Lynde compare Anne’s hair to?
She compares Anne’s hair to carrots.
Where does Marilla send Anne after Anne shouts at Mrs. Lynde?
She sends Anne to her room.
Who asks Anne to say sorry and changes her mind?
Matthew asks her, and Anne agrees to do it for him.
What does Anne tell Marilla about Green Gables on the way home?
She tells Marilla that she loves Green Gables and that it is her home now.

title: The Party
teaser: A missing brooch puts Anne’s plans for the party in danger.
questions: What did Anne put on her hat on the way to church?
She put yellow flowers on it.
What did Marilla lose the day before the party?
She lost her old brooch.
Where did Anne say the brooch fell?
She said it fell into the river by the bridge.
Why did Anne make up a story about the brooch?
She thought Marilla would let her go to the party if she told her a story about it.
Where did Marilla find the brooch?
She found it on her coat.

title: Love and Hate
teaser: Anne finds a best friend and meets Gilbert Blythe at school.
questions: Where does Diana Barry live?
She lives at Orchard Slope, across the river from Green Gables.
What do Anne and Diana sometimes do with books?
They read books together.
What did Gilbert call Anne when he took her hair in his hand?
He called her “Carrots.”
What did Anne do with her slate?
She hit Gilbert on the head with it, and the slate broke.
Where did Anne decide to study after Mr. Phillips made her sit next to Gilbert?
She decided to study at home.

title: Diana Comes to Tea
teaser: A mix-up at tea time puts Anne and Diana’s friendship to the test.
questions: What did Anne think she was giving Diana to drink?
She thought she was giving her fruit cordial.
What was really in the bottle?
There was red wine in the bottle.
Why did Anne go back to school after Mrs. Barry’s decision?
She went back because she wanted to see Diana at school.
What is Anne doing when Diana runs into the kitchen for help?
She is studying her lessons at the kitchen table.
Why does Mrs. Barry change her mind about Anne?
Anne helps Minnie May when she is very sick, and Mrs. Barry is thankful.

title: A Cake for Mrs. Allan
teaser: Anne bakes a cake for the new minister’s wife.
questions: Who did Marilla invite to tea on Wednesday?
She invited Mr. and Mrs. Allan.
What was really in the vanilla bottle?
There was medicine in the bottle.
Why did Marilla put medicine in the vanilla bottle?
She put it there because she broke the medicine bottle.
What does Mrs. Allan ask Anne to show her?
She asks Anne to show her the flowers.
Who is coming to teach in Avonlea after the vacation?
Miss Muriel Stacy is coming to teach in Avonlea.

title: An Accident and a New Dress
teaser: A risky game stops the fun at Diana’s party. Later, Matthew plans a Christmas surprise.
questions: What did Anne try to climb at Diana’s party?
She tried to climb to the top of Diana’s house.
How long did Anne stay at home after the accident?
She stayed at home for seven weeks.
Who helped Matthew get a pretty dress for Anne?
Mrs. Lynde helped him.
When did Matthew give Anne the dress?
He gave it to her on Christmas morning.
What did Anne say at the Christmas concert?
She said two poems.

title: Some Stupid Mistakes
teaser: Hair dye and an old boat bring Anne two big surprises.
questions: What color did Anne want her hair to be?
She wanted it to be black.
What color did the dye make Anne’s hair?
It made her hair green.
What did Marilla do when the green color stayed in Anne’s hair?
She cut Anne’s hair short.
What did Anne hold on to when water came into the boat?
She held on to a large tree.
Who pulled Anne into his boat?
Gilbert Blythe pulled her into his boat.

title: The Queen’s College Class
teaser: Anne and her classmates work toward a place at Queen’s College.
questions: What job does Anne want to do?
She wants to be a teacher.
Who offers to pay for Anne to go to Queen’s College?
Marilla and Matthew offer to pay.
When do the students in the Queen’s College class study together?
They study together after school.
Where did the students take their examinations?
They took them in Charlottetown.
Who came first in the examinations?
Anne and Gilbert came first together.

title: A New Start
teaser: Anne makes a difficult choice about her future and Green Gables.
questions: What did Anne win at the end of her year at Queen’s College?
She won a free place at Redmond College.
Who was Anne’s first friend at Green Gables?
Matthew was her first friend there.
Why did Marilla think she had to sell Green Gables?
The bank had problems, and she lost her money.
Why does Anne decide to stay on Prince Edward Island?
She wants to teach and help Marilla at Green Gables.
Where does Gilbert decide to teach so Anne can work in Avonlea?
He decides to teach at the White Sands school.
